meta.name: qwen3-asr-assistant
meta.description: 智能语音转文字助手，基于 Qwen3-ASR 模型，支持实时语音识别和智能文本改写。可以将录音转换为文字，并一键改写成邮件、笔记、社交媒体文案，支持复制、分享和录音拼接。适用于会议纪要、语音备忘、内容创作等多种场景。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将录音转为文字并改写成多种格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把录音快速转成文字并整理成文档。
copy.tagline_en: Convert recordings to text and rewrite into multiple formats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly transcribe recordings and organize them into documents.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能接收录音或音频文件，将其转成文字，并改写成邮件、笔记或社交媒体文案，还支持多段录音拼接、复制和分享。
howto.when: 当你提出“语音转文字”、“录音转文字”、“语音备忘”等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我转写这段会议录音，并整理成笔记。
say.note: Claude 会转写音频并生成结构化笔记。

say.text: 把这段语音备忘改写成邮件。
say.note: Claude 会转写并生成正式邮件。

say.text: 我有三段录音，帮我拼接成完整文字。
say.note: Claude 会依次转写并智能拼接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can receive recordings or audio files, transcribe them to text, and rewrite into emails, notes, or social media posts. It also supports merging multiple recordings, copying, and sharing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request 'voice to text', 'recording to text', 'voice memo', or similar tasks.

say_en.text: Transcribe this meeting recording and organize it into notes.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe and generate structured notes.

say_en.text: Rewrite this voice memo into an email.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe and generate a formal email.

say_en.text: I have three recordings, please merge them into one text.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe each and intelligently concatenate.
